result.rationale: CAND::7 (Sec 3) and CAND::8 (Sec 4.2) both explicitly state that the shortest-path-tree topology is treated as public/fixed while actually depending on private weights, directly exposing the annotated false assumption underlying the privacy proofs.
Both identify that the privacy analysis wrongly treats shortest path tree topology as public/independent of private data, invalidating the DP composition/accounting claims in Theorem 3.1.
